mentions.name: Nimstrata
mentions.description: Nimstrata puts Google's Vertex AI product discovery algorithms onto Shopify and Salesforce ecommerce storefronts, making it easier for less technical users to adopt Google Cloud APIs.
mentions.problem: Google lacks a product culture, leaving room for companies to make adopting Google Cloud APIs much easier for less technical users.
mentions.audience: Less technical users running Shopify and Salesforce ecommerce storefronts.
mentions.source_excerpt: We've been building https://nimstrata.com/ for almost three years now, we put Google's Vertex AI product discovery algorithms on Shopify and Salesforce ecommerce storefronts.
